_readme: Player-facing release notes, newest first, shown by the Change Log button in the lobby. Rules (full text: HOUSE RULES #2 in CLAUDE.md): at most ONE entry per day, id = date. If today's entry exists, rewrite it as one summary of the whole day; do not add a second entry. At most 5 lines per entry. Only list changes players will notice; group small fixes into one 'Small fixes and polish' line. Simple English, no file names, no em dashes.

entries.title: Change Log, password recovery, cleaner lobby
changes: New Change Log button in the lobby. It shows what changed in each update.
You can now add a recovery email in Profile > Settings > Account. If you forget your password, use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen.
The lobby keeps itself up to date, so the refresh buttons are gone. If a host reloads or closes the page, their room now closes right away instead of staying in the game list.
No more separate "All Slots Full" popup. If you pick up a scroll with a full hand, the Scroll Overflow banner asks you to cascade at the end of your turn.
Fixed the Start Game button staying grayed out after leaving a game, and "already in this room" after a reload. Bot training now pays at most 300 gold a day. Plus small fixes to game text.
